# Provenance check

- Identify external design systems articles code or assets influencing the change.
- Distinguish general design ideas from copied text code or visual assets.
- Read `PROVENANCE.md` when present and keep it aligned.
- Preserve required attribution and license terms for derived material.
- Prefer original examples when copying is unnecessary.
- Remove unsupported affiliation certification or ownership implications.
